title: v0.99.92 — Session Lifecycle Thinning, Reassessment & Series Closure
description: Frozen from v0.99.87 W4. Extract coherent pure lifecycle responsibilities, reassess the repository, and close the 32-wave series. MA-10 terminal; MA-11/MA-12 guards. Broad gates after W2 and W5.

waves.title: v0.99.92 W0 — Lifecycle trace and responsibility map
waves.body:
## Goal
Trace run-prompt normal/error/cancel/close/retry/compaction paths and classify responsibilities. No production change.

## Gate
Characterization + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Complete ordered effect/event map covers every exceptional exit.

waves.title: v0.99.92 W1 — Pure prompt preparation extraction
waves.body:
## Goal
Extract only pure user-input/config to preparation-plan transformations.

## Gate
Lifecycle/prompt + Arch + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Effect order and observable behavior remain unchanged.

waves.title: v0.99.92 W2 — Context-build request/result boundary
waves.body:
## Goal
Introduce explicit context-build request/result while preserving Runtime Context Assembly and session-owned cross-turn state.

## Gate
Broad + rollback/session ownership/context assembly + review.

## Acceptance
Ownership boundaries and traces remain intact.

waves.title: v0.99.92 W3 — Orchestration surface reduction
waves.body:
## Goal
Move only coherent private helpers; optimize change locality/test amplification, not LOC.

## Gate
Lifecycle + agent-session + iteration DI + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Composition root remains explicit and locality/testability measurably improve.

waves.title: v0.99.92 W4 — Repository-wide maintainability reassessment
waves.body:
## Goal
Repeat v0.99.87 baseline and classify all findings CLOSED/PARTIAL/OPEN/REJECTED.

## Gate
Architecture/document review + Fast.

## Acceptance
Every finding has reproducible current evidence and terminal/follow-up decision.

waves.title: v0.99.92 W5 — Series closure and release
waves.body:
## Goal
Complete traceability, synchronize projections, and publish the final series release.

## Gate
Broad + Arch + Security + Workflow + Smoke + Release + Manifest/Bundle + Main CI + independent review.

## Acceptance
No open Critical/High lacks follow-up; zero stale tracking; public artifacts match merge SHA/tag.
